summary: Build practical waste minimization and remediation skills with audits, KPIs, site screening, and action plans. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Hazardous waste training for environmental managers, waste coordinators, remediation specialists, and EHS professionals covers waste characterization and source reduction. Participants practise building a waste register, mapping material flows, calculating waste metrics, and screening contamination. They also compare remediation options and develop monitoring plans, with laboratory interpretation, GIS evidence, and AI-assisted data review introduced at an operational awareness level.
audienceIntro: Waste minimization training is designed for professionals who influence waste generation, environmental controls, contaminated-site decisions, or sustainability reporting. You can apply the course whether you work in manufacturing, construction, mining, energy, utilities, logistics, property, public infrastructure, or another sector with material and site impacts.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to environmental management, waste handling, EHS controls, sustainability reporting, facilities operations, process engineering, or contaminated-site work. Familiarity with waste records, environmental audits, or site investigation reports will help. No programming is required. Spreadsheet experience is useful for the measurement and dashboard exercises.
